profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Results-driven Engineer with a strong technical background in software engineering, specializing in coordinating cross-functional teams—both internal and external—to deliver projects that align with company objectives, customer requirements, timelines, and budgets. In the medical device industry, I have led project development initiatives, conducted root cause analysis and debugging, while prioritizing long-term device sustainability, manufacturing efficiency, and user needs. As a collaborative leader, I thrive in goal-oriented team environments. Looking ahead, I aim to expand my leadership scope by orchestrating multi-team collaborations to optimize project efficiency, balance technical debt with business priorities, and drive market-leading products for maximum profitability.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as module lead, overseeing project management for a team of five software engineers on the next-generation electrosurgical generator.
Analyzed program increment requirements against business milestones, and project increments, to identify critical paths and dependencies. Created and prioritized JIRA stories and epics, assigning resources based on timelines, expertise, and junior talent development.
Developed high-level effort estimates by comparing predecessor product metrics with key differentiators in the new design.
Facilitated ongoing discussions on trade-offs between organizational priorities, technical debt, and engineering opportunities to sustain market position.
Contributed individually to front-end Gui, alarm manager, and configuration data management components of the embedded system, incorporating foresight from the organization's product pipeline, including interoperability and robotic surgery.

Managed technical project aspects for minor software releases driven by end-of-life components, serving as the key coordinator for scope definition.
Provided strategic recommendations on release inclusions, evaluating hardware necessities, customer feedback, manufacturability, and business impacts on future product timelines.
Devised cross-team strategies to integrate internal contractors from diverse management structures, ensuring alignment with non-contractor workforce goals.
Conducted risk assessments and root cause investigations on field reports, determining necessary additions to maintain market leadership and product integrity.

Mentored new hires and summer interns, guiding their integration into multi-year project lifecycles and promoting a product-oriented mindset.
Reviewed initial tasks, explained their integration into overall project architecture, provided guidance and examples, and conducted follow-ups to address progress and challenges.
Focused on enabling meaningful contributions while building skills for long-term success.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Spearheaded software development for a major update to the flagship electrosurgical generator, delivering new features, addressing end-of-life components, and enhancing security protocols. Collaborated seamlessly with cross-functional teams—including marketing, manufacturing, and data analytics—to ensure robust solutions that prioritized patient safety, met customer requirements, and aligned with business objectives in a fast-paced Agile environment.
GUI Refactoring with C++ Qt: Architected a modular GUI interface by abstracting energy delivery methods, enabling flexible feature configurations at deployment. This streamlined the company’s device portfolio, reducing software maintenance costs and optimizing manufacturing workflows.
Drove Feature Design Collaboration: Partnered with human factors, marketing, and development teams to design and implement customer-centric product enhancements, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with user needs.
Optimized On-Device Database Strategy: Designed and implemented an efficient database creation approach to minimize software update package sizes while maintaining stringent patient safety standards.
Integrated Wayland Weston Window Manager: Diagnosed and resolved faulty screen updates during a Qt5 library migration by integrating Wayland Weston into a Yocto Linux-based Qt5 project, ensuring robust display performance.
Thrived in Agile Workflow: Actively contributed to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, driving iterative progress and maintaining alignment with project milestones.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a Class A/Minor medical device for plasma-rich platelet separation, focusing on the design and implementation of an embedded Linux-based user interface and comprehensive UI documentation. Ensured project success through robust architecture supporting continuous integration, automated unit testing, and a functional simulator, all within an Agile workflow.
Designed GUI with C++ QtWidgets: Built an event-driven GUI with integrated unit testing, ensuring high reliability and maintainability for the medical device’s user interface.
Managed Customer-Driven UI Design: Collaborated with clients under timeline, budget, and design constraints to craft intuitive GUI workflows, delivering win-win solutions that kept projects on schedule while earning client trust.
Authored Requirements and Documentation: Partnered with Software Quality Assurance (SWQA) and project leads to produce requirements and design documentation, addressing medical device design constraints with precision.
Operated in Agile Environment: Delivered iterative progress through Agile practices.

positions.title: Electrical/Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for design update burn-in tests for new and existing products to ensure the effectiveness, quality, and safety of the products
exceeded customer expectations. My test scenarios aided in the development of new products by ensuring the design meets requirements.
As a side benefit of the testing results I was able to design software for manufacturing to program hardware to save time and reduce human
error.
▪ Design GUI interfaces using C++ QtWidgets to test functionality and repeatability of products.
▪ Design and build testing hardware/equipment.
▪ Following products through manufacturing to ensure quality

positions.title: Lockheed Martin Electrical Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Responsible for arcflash investigation to keep facility compliant with National Electric Code.
Coordinated with engineers, IT, and electricians to complete projects on time and on budget.
Provide mitigation strategies for over duty equipment.
Write best practice documentation for arcflash investigation.
Drafting new and ongoing projects on Micro Station and Easy Power.
